D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Pete Aguilar leads by 33.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 85,631 votes; a one point swing is about 1,280 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +26.2 and D +40.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
